header.title: Software Engineer | QA Engineer | Automation | AI
header.description: I combine software engineering, QA and automation to build reliable applications. I work with Java and Selenium, APIs, Salesforce and Full Stack development, as well as AI and LLM solutions.

biography.title: My Journey
biography.para1: I am a Software Engineer and QA Engineer with experience in Full Stack development, test automation, APIs, data and systems integration. I currently work as a Quality Analyst at NTT DATA, working with Salesforce, Java, Selenium, REST APIs and process automation.
biography.para2: I have experience developing web and mobile applications, designing APIs, automating tests, working with databases, and building solutions with AI and LLMs. I also develop independent projects, applying architecture practices, CI/CD, automated testing and software quality.
biography.para3: My goal is to grow as a Software Engineer, deepening my work in systems architecture, automation and intelligent solutions to real business problems.

portfolio.title: Featured Projects
portfolio.subtitle: Six projects connecting architecture, business rules, integrations and software quality.

projects.title: ALG Gestão — Rental Management System
projects.description: Native Android app built with Kotlin and MVVM/Repository, offline operation with Room, and a REST API using Node.js/Express, Sequelize and MySQL to manage the rental lifecycle.
highlights: Client, contract, equipment and return management, with JWT authentication, access roles and database isolation.
PDF generation and signature capture within contract workflows.
Financial dashboards and backup routines.
Unit and instrumented testing strategy.
projects.businessImpact: Centralized rental operations and continuity of work offline.

projects.title: ERP Anduril — Financial Management
projects.description: Desktop system built with Electron, React, TypeScript and NestJS to manage clients, contracts, land, documents and bank payment slips.
highlights: SQLite with transactions and automatic backups for local operation.
CNAB 240 banking integration with remittance generation and return-file processing.
Excel data export and financial routine automation.
Multi-layer validation, structured logging and global error handling.
projects.businessImpact: Organized financial management and integration between administrative and banking workflows.

projects.title: CRM SaaS — Sales Management Platform
projects.description: Multi-tenant platform built with Java 21, Spring Boot, Next.js, MySQL and Docker, with data isolation and separate API, frontend and control plane.
highlights: Management of leads, companies, opportunities, visits and the sales pipeline.
Flyway migrations and schema validation with ddl-auto=validate.
Quality gates with testing, coverage, Sonar and CI/CD.
DDD, ADRs, Spec-Driven Development and testable acceptance criteria to guide system evolution.
projects.businessImpact: Sales management per organization, with data isolation and traceable technical decisions.

projects.title: Real-Time Services Platform
projects.description: Platform under development with a NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis and Socket.IO backend, integrated with a React Native/Expo mobile application.
highlights: Geolocation, professional matching and notifications to connect customers with service providers.
Chat and live tracking throughout service delivery.
Redis for geolocation, locks and asynchronous processing.
Unit, integration and acceptance tests with Vitest, Supertest and Testcontainers.
projects.businessImpact: Connecting customers and professionals with real-time service tracking.

projects.businessImpact: Applying AI to business workflows and automation within Salesforce.

Full administrative dashboard for managing appointments and practice operations.
Responsive, professional institutional design built with Tailwind CSS.
